d: India won the Under-19 Asia Cup final against Pakistan in a last-ball thriller. Yet, the post-match celebrations involving India's U-19 cricketers like Lakshya Raichandani and Yashveer Goud have become almost as big a talking point as the result itself. From aggressive celebrations and heated exchanges to questions about sportsmanship, the India vs Pakistan final has reopened an important debate about how young cricketers should conduct themselves on the field. Rupha Ramani discusses the fine line between passion and provocation in cricket.
